findings.issue: The summary identifies iteration 10 as the cap, yet production code was changed and published in iteration 13 and the workflow has now reached a sixteenth implementer tick. The current tick is bookkeeping-only, but it cannot undo the cap violation.
findings.consequence: Another implementation tick in this workflow would violate the governing stop condition.
findings.correction: Stop this loop after this review, preserve the published linear history without reset/revert/force operations, and carry the product findings into a separately authorized run.

findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting security — mandatory idempotency for Super Admin tenant creation
findings.issue: POST /v1/platform/tenants is replaySafe rather than idempotent. definePlatformRoute therefore executes the write without an Idempotency-Key, as existing successful tests demonstrate; retrying a lost keyless response reruns no-slug provisioning, whose collision path creates a random-suffixed second tenant.
findings.consequence: One intended Super Admin operation can create duplicate properties, owners, inventory, policy, and audit history.
findings.correction: Require Idempotency-Key on tenant creation, update all callers/tests, assert keyless rejection and exact-key replay of one property, and cover lost-response retry plus in-flight submit in the rendered Platform form.

findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting data integrity — atomic, recoverable platform idempotency
findings.issue: The platform reservation insert, tenant/member business mutation, and response finalization are separate autocommits. There is no lease, reconciliation, or durable operation identity on the created resource. A failure after the business mutation commits but before finalization leaves status=0 permanently; exact retry returns request_in_progress while a fresh key can rerun provisioning.
findings.consequence: A successfully created property can be stranded behind permanent 409 responses or duplicated during recovery.
findings.correction: Atomically bind idempotency completion/result identity to the business mutation, or persist a unique operation ID that lets stale reservations reconstruct the committed result. Add fault-injection coverage for failure after business commit but before finalization.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 — recoverable local-auth person and owner onboarding
findings.issue: Local creation stores only the generated password hash, while replay storage replaces temporaryPassword with null. If the first committed response is lost, replay returns 201 without the only credential; People/Platform then report an invitation even though local auth created no invitation, and the forgot/reset path is exposed only for external auth.
findings.consequence: A created member or a new property's only owner can exist but be unable to sign in.
findings.correction: Provide a recoverable setup/invitation or authenticated credential-reset flow with an explicit replay outcome while keeping secrets out of replay storage. Test lost-response retries for tenant owner, tenant member, and platform member through first local sign-in.

findings.issue: The rendered join starts from a fabricated token, mounts GuestPass directly, replaces the scanner, and mocks lookup/redeem. Separate API tests cover two-hour expiry, HMAC rejection, and stored verify_code mismatch, but no recorded execution joins a server-generated pass to the real Resident Share control, public /pass bootstrap, decoded guest QR, and real gate validation.
findings.consequence: The exact artifact produced by the live flow has not been shown to survive sharing and redeem as the same valid pass.
findings.correction: In a future authorized run, execute a routed mobile-browser story from live pass issue through Share, /pass fragment bootstrap, QR decode, and real lookup/redeem; assert exact token identity, two-hour unused expiry, HMAC tamper rejection, and stored verify_code mismatch rejection.

findings.criterion: 3 and 4 — real camera plate scanning at check-in and check-out
findings.issue: Rendered tests replace LiveCamera with a button that emits an already-decoded plate. No recorded run executes getUserMedia, the shipped ONNX loader/decoder, a camera fixture, and responsive browser rendering; the existing camera story covers check-in only.
findings.consequence: Actual camera acquisition and model decoding remain unverified in the shipped stack for both required flows.
findings.correction: In a future authorized run, run and record a 390x844 real-model fake-camera check-in story and add/run checkout coverage, asserting filled fields, match/result, model/browser/fixture versions, stopped tracks, and a clean console.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 — complete real-stack CRUD and cross-property operations
findings.issue: Rendered CRUD tests mock every API and complete a full lifecycle only for a unit; person is create-only, site/zone/slot lifecycles are incomplete, and cross-property coverage is one mocked member POST. Setting innerWidth in jsdom does not execute mobile CSS layout, and no real-stack browser run is recorded.
findings.consequence: Persisted administration, complete cross-property Super Admin behavior, server authorization boundaries, and narrow-screen usability remain unverified in context.
findings.correction: In a future authorized run, execute full create/read/edit/delete-or-retire lifecycles for person, site/building, unit, and slot through the real routed UI/API at a narrow viewport; perform representative all-entity operations in a second property as Super Admin and prove regular-admin server denial.
